subject: c-cont
title: TRS.------C.CONT.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 179 (SR(TRS)II-35). C-CONT (composite continuance) is the subject; TRS (transition) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From DYM-F: INFO-DE (information degrees). From INFO-DE: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PROG-CONT: RE-ST (restructuralism), S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation) and DOC (documentation), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From S-ST: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From DOC: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From T-C-IMP: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits).
